title: Burned memo / Project Aquarius references Zodiac
summary: UAPGerb tells of Burned memo / Project Aquarius references Zodiac, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the uh burned memo or the project Aquarius, one of them, I can't remember which, actually makes reference to project zodiac

plain: A researcher who posts online as UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels's podcast that one of two documents, either a so-called burned memo or a paper about a government effort called Project Aquarius, mentions another effort called Project Zodiac, though he cannot remember which. He credits a researcher named Lee Graham. If so, it would point to yet another hidden project.
